strategy.thesis: Panasonic — a consumer/industrial electronics maker — set up an ¥8B, 10-year CVC fund (2020) targeting startups in healthcare and energy among other fields, seeking synergy with its in-house technology (distinct from its separate Conductive Ventures US enterprise-software vehicle).

summary.en: Electronics conglomerate Panasonic's corporate VC fund (¥8B, established 2020, 10-year term) targets startups in healthcare and energy for synergy with Panasonic's in-house technology; separate from its US-focused Conductive Ventures enterprise-software vehicle.
